headline: SoftBank earnings exceed expectations, even without an OpenAI boost. This U.S. chip company saved the day.
detail: This is a strong positive signal for the chip sector, indicating robust underlying demand and performance. It directly supports your heavy concentration in tech/chip names.
rec: Consider adding to a core chip holding or initiating a new position. NVDA is on the scanner as ACCUMULATE (entry 219-218.78, stop 218.11).

headline: Hedge funds forced out of tech stocks may leave the market at the mercy of retail traders
detail: Less institutional support for tech could lead to increased volatility and less predictable price movements. Your concentrated tech portfolio on margin would feel these swings acutely.
rec: No direct trade, but this reinforces the need for caution and strict stop-loss adherence on your tech holdings, especially leveraged ones.

headline: Peloton posts first ever annual net profit, but shares drop as outlook disappoints
detail: This headline serves as a cautionary tale for growth-oriented tech stocks. Even with a positive earnings milestone, a weak outlook can severely punish valuations.
rec: No direct trade, but it highlights the importance of forward guidance for your growth-heavy tech portfolio. Be ready to act if your holdings show similar outlook weakness.
